turns.replyText:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.

For live plants:

We do not accept standard returns on live plants.
If a plant arrives with a condition concern, we ask you to contact us right away with photos so our team can review it.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, perennials by a 90-day guarantee, and bulbs by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

For non-plant items:

A normal return is for an unused item you no longer want.
Tools and hard goods can be returned within 30 days of delivery in new condition, and return shipping is the customer’s responsibility.

If an item arrived damaged:

We ask for details and photos first so the team can review the situation.
That review is different from a standard return request.

If you want, send me the item name plus your order number or email address, and I can tell you the right next step.
